blocks.text: Scene 01 — UI में ऐसे prose दिखेगा
6:35 PM · Ahuja Residence

Shivani ghar pahunchi toh Om Uncle dining table par society programme ki list lekar baithe the. Rohan sofa par Tara ko picture book dikha raha tha. Din bhar college aur society ke kaam ke baad bhi Shivani ki nazar seedha list par gayi.
Om: “Shivani, registration counter ki final jagah confirm ho gayi?”
Shivani: “Left corridor, Om Uncle. Bas Deepu se display placement check karna hai. Phir aaj ka kaam khatam.”
Tara ne book chhodkar dono haath Shivani ki taraf badhaye. Shivani ne use pyaar kiya, Rohan se kaha ki woh thodi der mein lautegi, aur Kavya ke liye message chhod diya ki ready hokar neeche aa jaaye.
Rohan muskuraya. “Programme khatam karke aana. New Year ghar mein bhi hai.”
Shivani ne haste hue bag rakha aur final check ke liye neeche nikal gayi.
Episode 04A · Shivani · Scene 02
Scene 02 — Ek Nazar Ka Raaz
1 January 2026 · 6:51 PM · Gulmohar Heights, Community Hall

Community hall mein New Year programme ki taiyari abhi chal rahi thi. Stage ke paas decorative lights lag chuki thi. Registration counter ka front panel set tha, bas neeche ki LED strip ek jagah se theek se fit nahi ho rahi thi.
Deepu counter ke neeche baithkar wiring check kar raha tha.
Shivani andar aayi toh usne pehle stage, phir registration desk par nazar daali.
Shivani: “Deepu, abhi tak yahin ho? Mujhe laga tumne final display ready kar diya hoga.”
Deepu: “Ready hai, didi. Bas neeche wali light thoda nakhra kar rahi hai.”
Shivani: “Achha? Tumhari tarah?”
Deepu hans diya.
Deepu: “Main toh aapki saari baatein maanta hoon.”
Shivani counter ke saamne aakar khadi hui. Usne QR code scan karke dekha. Link sahi khul raha tha, lekin front panel ek taraf se halka tedha tha.
Shivani: “Yeh left side thoda andar karo. Door se uneven lag raha hai.”
Deepu neeche se panel ki fitting adjust karne laga.
Shivani bhi counter par jhuki aur ungli se usse exact jagah dikhane lagi.
Uske kandhe par rakha ivory dupatta aage khisak aaya.
Woh seedhi hui, dupatta sambhala aur dobara jhukkar panel ka corner dekha. Is baar dupatta phir beech mein aa gaya.
Shivani: “Uff! Ek minute.”
Usne dupatta kandhe par theek se set kiya, lekin teesri baar panel ki taraf jhukte hi woh phir neeche sarak gaya.
Shivani ne ek chhoti si pareshan hansi chhodi.
Shivani: “Deepu, ise kahin taang doon? Baar-baar kaam mein aa raha hai.”
Neeche se awaaz aayi.
Deepu: “Haan didi, wahaan side mein hook hai. Taang dijiye.”
Shivani ne dupatta utaarkar paas wale wall hook par latka diya. Phir apne deep-plum kurte ko ek baar set kiya aur dobara counter ke paas aa gayi.
Shivani: “Haan, ab batao.”
Counter ke neeche cool-white LED strip jal rahi thi. Deepu ek haath se cable pakde hue tha aur doosre se connector fit kar raha tha.
Shivani uske bataye hue corner ko dekhne ke liye aage jhuki.
Shivani: “Yahan? Ya thoda aur left?”
Deepu ne jawab dene ke liye sir uthaya.
Ek pal ke liye uska haath ruk gaya.
Shivani: “Deepu?”
Deepu: “Ji... haan. Thoda left.”
Woh phir cable ki taraf dekhne laga.
Shivani ne panel adjust kiya.
Shivani: “Ab?”
Deepu: “Ek second.”
Shivani dobara jhuki. LED ki roshni neeche se counter ke kinare aur uske aaspaas pad rahi thi.
Deepu ki nazar phir uthi.
Is baar usne turant jawab nahi diya.
Shivani: “Arre, tum bol bhi rahe ho ya mujhe poora counter khud hi lagana padega?”
Deepu: “Nahi, nahi, didi. Bas... screw tight kar raha tha.”
Shivani muskura di.
Shivani: “Itna concentration toh mere college ke students bhi nahi lagate.”
Deepu ne halka sa hansne ki koshish ki, lekin uski awaaz pehle jaisi nahi thi.
Woh ek baar gala saaf karke phir kaam karne laga.
Shivani ne notice kiya.
Shivani: “Kya hua? Paani chahiye?”
Deepu: “Nahi didi. Theek hoon.”
Shivani: “Pakka?”
Deepu: “Haan.”
Shivani ne kandhe uchkaye aur QR display ki alignment dobara check karne lagi.
Deepu ab kam bol raha tha. Kabhi fitting dekhta, kabhi Shivani ke sawaal ka jawab dene ke liye nazar uthata, aur phir jaldi se apne kaam mein lag jaata.
Shivani ko uski badli hui khamoshi samajh nahi aa rahi thi.
Abhi toh bada hans-hans kar jawab de raha tha. Achanak kya ho gaya isko?
Shivani: “Deepu, last check. Main yeh corner pakadti hoon, tum neeche se lock kar do.”
Deepu: “Ji.”
Shivani phir counter ki taraf jhuki.
Usi waqt stage ki taraf se ek halki click ki awaaz aayi.
Agle hi pal decoration aur stage-testing ki kai lights ek saath jal uthin.
Community hall ka woh hissa achanak tez roshni se bhar gaya.
Shivani ki nazar abhi bhi display ke corner par thi.
Shivani: “Arre wah! Ab toh saari lights ek saath chal gayin. Deepu, dekho—”
Uska sentence poora hone se pehle Deepu ki movement badal gayi.
Woh kuch do-teen seconds tak apni jagah par ruka raha. Phir cable chhodkar jaldi se counter ke neeche se nikla.
Usne Shivani se kuch nahi kaha.
Shivani doosri taraf ka panel check kar rahi thi.
Shivani: “Deepu? Ab toh achha lag raha hai na?”
Koi jawab nahi.
Usne phir kaha—
Shivani: “Deepu?”
Shivani seedhi hui aur peeche mudkar dekha.
Counter ke paas koi nahi tha.
Shivani: “Arre? Yeh kahan gaya?”
Neeche screwdriver aur cable wahin pade the. LED strip bhi jal rahi thi.
Shivani ne corridor ki taraf dekha, lekin Deepu nazar nahi aaya.
Bina bataye chala gaya? Abhi toh yahin tha.
Woh kuch pal khadi rahi. Phir uski nazar saamne ki deewar par lage bade mirror par padi.
Usne apna reflection dekha.
Kurte ko ek baar theek kiya. Phir uski nazar wall hook par latke dupatte par gayi.
Achha, yeh toh main yahin chhod aayi.
Woh hook tak gayi aur dupatta wapas kandhe par rakh liya.
Ek baar phir mirror mein khud ko dekha.
Deepu ka achanak chup ho jaana usse ab bhi thoda ajeeb lag raha tha, lekin uske paas koi wajah nahi thi.
Shivani: “Pata nahi aaj isko kya ho gaya.”
Usne final display ko door se dekha. Placement ab sahi tha.
Shivani ne phone nikala aur Kavya ka message check kiya.
Bas, ab yeh kaam bhi ho gaya. Kavya aati hi hogi.
Woh community hall ke entrance ki taraf chal di.
Deepu ne kya dekha tha, uska reaction achanak kyun badla aur woh bina kuch kahe kahan chala gaya—Shivani ke paas filhaal inmein se kisi sawaal ka jawab nahi tha.
Scene 03 — Pehli Mulaqat
1 January 2026 · 7:05 PM · Community Hall

Kavya hall mein pahunchi toh Shivani registration list check kar rahi thi. Deepu bhi paani peeke wapas aa gaya tha. Shivani ne dono ka introduction karaya. “Kavya, yeh Deepu hai. Aur Deepu, meri chhoti behen.” Deepu ne muskura kar namaste kiya. Kavya hans padi. “Itne formal kyun ho? Kavya bula sakte ho.” Deepu ne pehli baar uska naam liya toh Kavya ki smile thodi aur khil gayi.

Kavya ne programme sheet maangi. Deepu uske paas aaya aur dono counter par jhukkar print check karne lage. Kavya ne ek galat direction arrow pakad liya. “Yeh dekho, tum log guests ko doosre hall bhej doge!” Deepu hans pada. “Achha hua tum aa gayi.” Kavya ne uski taraf dekha. “Tum? Abhi toh aap bol rahe the.” Deepu muskura diya. “Tumne hi toh mana kiya tha.”

Shivani ne door se dono ko hanste dekha aur Kavya ko awaaz di. Jaate hue Kavya ne Deepu se kaha, “Kal milte hain, Mr. Decoration Expert.” Deepu ne jawab diya, “Pakka.” Kavya Shivani ke paas aayi toh uske chehre par ab bhi halki si smile thi. “Di, Deepu kaafi sweet hai.” Shivani ne use chheda, “Achha? Itni jaldi review bhi aa gaya?”
